g.text: Actual and predicted hourly electricity per gross floor area
Original first complete seven-day windows; 168 hourly observations per building; end dates are exclusive.
Panels use independent vertical scales. L14_B03 includes an actual-only inset because predictions are much larger.
Negative model predictions are retained without clipping. Models and targets are not retrained or shifted.
